component.name: TrickWork
component.summary: Turn pictures into ASCII art that fits any font

description.p: Most ASCII art tools pick characters by brightness and assume every letter is equally wide. TrickWork measures how much ink each character puts on the page in the font you chose, so the picture keeps its shape even in a proportional font. Every slider updates the preview straight away.

ul.li: A live preview that follows the font, the character set and every slider
Crop, rotate and flip, levels, brightness and contrast, invert, dithering, colour and sharpening
A batch queue for many pictures at once, where one broken file never holds up the rest
Export to plain text, XHTML, RTF and PNG
Presets you can save, share and load again

description.p: TrickWork needs no account, collects no analytics and keeps your pictures on your computer. The Flatpak opens and saves files through your desktop's own dialogs, so it reaches any folder you pick and no other. Your software centre brings the updates.

screenshot.caption: A knight's helmet as ASCII art, beside the Transform and Filters cards
Shape, theme, animations and rainbow colours in the Look settings

description.p: Uninstalling on Windows leaves nothing behind, and the Linux installer shows TrickWork's icon.
A title bar in TrickWork's own colours, new installers for Windows and Linux, and an installed app that starts in your system's language.
An Info tab in Settings with the version, a check for updates, the manual and a bug report you can attach to an issue.
